erroneous_objects.description: ASPA attestations that contain errors, whether due to certificate invalidity, incorrect provider sets, or both.

customer_asn.description: The customer ASN whose ASPA attestation contains errors

unauthorized_providers.description: ASNs listed as providers in the attestation that are not actual transit providers

missing_providers.description: ASNs that are actual transit providers but absent from the attestation

corrected_aspa.description: Corrected ASPA database. Keys are customer ASN strings, values are sorted arrays of correct provider ASNs. Include only ASes that had published attestations.

route_analysis.description: Verification results for each observed BGP route.

direction.description: Verification direction based on the relationship between receiver and neighbor

leak_source_asn.description: For Invalid routes: the AS that initiated the violating transit hop. Null for non-Invalid routes.

deployment_recommendation.description: ASes that should deploy ASPA attestations, ranked by the count of previously-unresolved routes each deployment would resolve (descending), ties broken by ascending ASN.

asn.description: The ASN that should deploy an ASPA attestation

provider_set.description: The correct provider set for this AS

resolves_routes.description: Route IDs that would change from Unknown to a definitive result
